prior_exposure: v1 SciFact/NFCorpus results and earlier ArguAna retrieval work seen. New target calibration outcomes not inspected. New tests do not erase prior exposure.
question: With the same 100 target labels, does target-only learning beat source-model intercept adaptation for judged retrieval-hit probability across lexical and dense retrieval?

splits.scifact: official train/test; exact normalized query deduplication; test preserved
splits.nfcorpus: official train/test; dev unused; exact normalized query deduplication; test preserved
splits.arguana: BEIR test queries repurposed: debate-ID groups hash split65/35;101 exact-text training duplicates/overlaps removed;496 heldout queries retained; missing positive qrels retained as unreachable
splits.scidocs: BEIR test queries repurposed: normalized query-text groups hash split,65% pool35%heldout

self_match_policy: Exclude document whose ID equals query ID for every retriever and QL auxiliary scoring
source_fit: Leave one collection out; up to600 eligible source queries per other collection selected by fixed group-independent hash; bootstrap those queries within source text/debate groups in each of20 repeats

ql_auxiliary.NQC: population SD of top100 QL scores / abs(collection query log-likelihood)
ql_auxiliary.WIG: (mean top100 QL scores - collection query log-likelihood)/sqrt(number of known query tokens)
ql_auxiliary.OOV: omit unseen tokens from QL; empty known query produces0features
ql_auxiliary.note: Standard score-only/unigram formulation; not full original MRF/proximity WIG

learning.offset: regularized intercept-only with summed log loss+delta^2/2
learning.platt: StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1 on source logits, target calibration only
learning.isotonic: IsotonicRegression increasing=true, out_of_bounds=clip; one-class falls back to smoothed prior
learning.oneclass: Jeffreys-smoothed prior fallback; retained and counted

primary_family.contrast: target_only minus offset_adapt mean Brier at100targetlabels; negative favors target-only
primary_family.multiplicity: Four simultaneous comparisons using98.75% marginal percentile intervals (Bonferroni95% familywise)
primary_family.bootstrap: 5000 crossed resamples: fit-repeat indices and heldout query groups; paired predictions retained across methods; conditional on observed collections/pools
primary_family.scope: Captures stochastic source refits/calibration draw variability and test-query variation conditional on these observed pools; not population uncertainty over unseen collections

secondary: risk/coverage at fixedp0.8 and risk-coverage curves
data_audits: cross-collection exact normalized text leakage removed from source pool against target heldout
no source fitting on target corpus labels
stopping_rules: Abort model inference on hash mismatch/nonfinite embeddings
If a collection pool has fewer than100 queries stop and record amended protocol before outcomes
No hyperparameter or method selection based on test outcomes
